meta.title: Dimension-Based Routing: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a non-Tenant Admin user and verify Dimension-Based Routing is refused or absent.
Repeat the same action as a Tenant Admin and verify Dimension-Based Routing is available.
Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan and record any RBAC configuration that grants access to other roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a non-Tenant Admin user and verify Dimension-Based Routing is refused or absent.; Repeat the same action as a Tenant Admin and verify Dimension-Based Routing is available.; Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan and record any RBAC configuration that grants access to other roles.

args.need: sign in as the non-Tenant Admin user and the Tenant Admin user on the same Enterprise tenant, test Dimension-Based Routing approval routing by department, state, or category for both users, and report whether it is refused or absent for the first user and available for the Tenant Admin

steps.note: The catalog cannot sign in as these role-specific users or observe the Dimension-Based Routing feature.
Confirm the session remains free of a visible application error after the tester's role comparison.
